description: Baseline: 82x22 fixed window, monochrome, no colour, tiny playlist, big empty space. Minimal player.
Responsive sizing (60%x50%), cyan accent colours on volume/progress/icons, numbered playlist, compact layout, idle viz breathing pattern. Still too much empty space.
Larger window (65%x65%), stronger idle viz breathing (0.25 amp), horizontal separator, inline keyboard hints with vol, playlist header. Viz fills lower half with cyan bars + orange peaks.
